knowledge.purpose: A single date, time or date-time field (native input, or an opt-in month calendar for dates); submits ISO text under its name
useCases: One end of a date filter over a timestamped table (two inputs, each with its own stateKey)
Booking start / end as two fields
Edit form pre-filled from the record through defaultValue
A booking day that is never a Sunday (disabledWeekdays: [0])
antiPatterns: Free-text date entry in a plain input — date-input submits ISO text the backend can parse
A single range picker — this is one date; use two date-inputs for a range
Recurring schedule — out of scope for a single date input
knowledge.implementation: mode: date | time | datetime. calendar:true (date mode only) opens a month grid; the value still reaches the form as ISO yyyy-MM-dd. required is enforced in both modes. The calendar is keyboard-complete: arrows move a day / a week, Home/End the week's start/end, PageUp/PageDown a month (Shift: a year), Enter picks, Esc or a press outside closes it from anywhere and Esc returns focus to the field; each day is named in full ("Wednesday, 18 November 2026"). disabledWeekdays (0 = Sunday) greys those days out and the form refuses one in either mode. On a phone the field, the day cells and the month arrows are 44px targets.

jsonSchema.description: true → popover month calendar (locale display + ISO hidden input for FormData); false → native date input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial ISO value (yyyy-MM-dd, HH:mm or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm). Bind it to a record field in an edit form.

jsonSchema.description: The value page state holds — bind it to the key the field writes ("{{state.<stateKey>}}"). Wins over defaultValue, so a field that mounts again (a wizard step hidden and shown again) shows the date the visitor picked. An unresolved binding is ignored.

props.name: stateKey
props.description: State key the ISO value is written to on change; `{{state.<key>}}` then reads it (a date filter, a summary step).

props.name: disabledWeekdays
props.description: Weekdays that cannot be picked: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (numbers, numeric strings, or a comma-separated string such as "0,6"). The calendar greys them out (still reachable by the arrow keys, never pickable) and a form refuses such a date in either mode.
